devanagari: ऐ जून ओयर ढाः उन ओयर ढाः इन्, अणुण जरा ढाः इन्, अनङ्गान् गणिन् गण आइयण इन् उण्डुकौ
romanization: Ai jūn oyara ḍhāḥ un oyara ḍhāḥ In aṇuṇ Jarā ḍhāḥ In anaṅgān gaṇin gaṇ āiyaṇa In Jarā ḍhāḥ Uṇḍukau
translation: Remember the stubborn Avatar Serpents, the guilty Avatar Serpents, the Lord, the Whole Ancient Serpent Lord, Multiple Naga Kings, the Commander and the Troops of Shiva who received the Lord, the Ancient Serpents, and the Two Leprosies.

devanagari: ऐए  ऐया अंग ऐन इन् जरा ढाः आन यानिन् इङ्ग् गोङ्कयोः जरा ढाः इन् इन्दून् गोखैः अट् मूकौ ऐ इन् जेऱ्हा अन् गूकौ हो
romanization: Aiye aṅga aiy ain In Jarā ḍhāḥ ān yānin iṅg goṅkayoḥ Jarā ḍhāḥ indūn gokhaiḥ aṭ mūkau ai In jeṛhā an gūkau ho
translation: The two female ascetic (nuns) and the limb, at the height, the Lord and the Ancient Serpents, the heyday, had a vehicle to stir. Concerning the two Gonkas, the Ancient Serpents, and the Lord, the Soma drops by means of the cow holes, and the wandering two Muted Ones - remember the Lord [was] overcome by the Soul and the two fish (Revati Nakshatra – last section of Pisces constellation?).

devanagari: मांग ऐ जून ढौ इमौ खोः
romanization: Māṅga ai jūn ḍhau imau khoḥ
translation: Mang people remember the stubborn two Serpents, these two of the two skies.

devanagari: ऐ जून जगे जुन् गोः इन् ज्ञान ढाः अङ्गौ कोचौ ऐयारो अंग जरा ढाः सेण गिहि
romanization: Ai jūn jage jun goḥ In jñāna ḍhāḥ aṅgau kocau aiyāro aṅg Jarā ḍhāḥ In seṇ gihi
translation: Remember the Mankind who moved the Nine and the Lord, [who] understood the Serpents and the two limbs [were the] transgressor - the limb, the Ancient Serpents, the Lord, and the Military House Holder.

devanagari: भंग ओइ औ अंग जरा ढाः मच्च ढौकौ
romanization: Bhaṅg oi au aṅga Jarā ḍhāḥ dehin ḍhaukau
translation: Oh, the ruin! Ananta Shesha, the limb, the Ancient Serpents, the corporeal body, and the two Moving Ones.

devanagari: भंग ओइ अंग हिंग हि हिंग ओइ जरा ढाः इन् गेहिन् घण् अङ्क् शिणीक केके खे मूकौ हो
romanization: Bhaṅg oi aṅg oi hi hiṅg oi Jarā ḍhāḥ In gehin ghaṇ aṅk śiṇīk [kkkk] keke khe mūkau ho
translation: Oh, the ruin! Oh, the limb! Oh, the Forsaken and the Resin! The Ancient Serpents—the Lord and the Wife of the Householder shined and went crookedly—a shooting pain in the limbs [extend pain sound]. The two cries of a peacock—the two skies (heavens)—the two Muted Ones.

devanagari: ऐ जून ओयरा ढाः इन्धे मूकौ हो
romanization: Ai jūn oyarā ḍhāḥ indhe mūkau ho
translation: Remember the stubborn two Avatar Serpents [who were] tempted by the two Muted Ones.

devanagari: ऐ जून नव जरा ढाः इन्धे कय हय् मूकौ यरादी इन् शिङ्गे हय् मूकौ हो
romanization: Ai jūn nau Jarā ḍhāḥ Indhe kay hay mūkau yāradī In śiṅge hay mūkau ho
translation: Remember the stubborn Nine Ancient Serpents tempted the Assembly to worship The Two Silenced Ones—the hereditary office—the Lord in the Youth worshiped the two Silenced Ones.

devanagari: ऐ जून जरा ढाः ईशे शे शेषे मूकौ हो इन्दून् जरा ढाः उण्डुकौ हो
romanization: Ai jūn Jarā ḍhāḥ īśe śe śeṣe mūkau ho indūn Jarā ḍhāḥ uṇḍukau ho
translation: Remember the stubborn Ancient Serpents in Śiva—He Reclines and Ananta Shesha—the two Muted Ones were the Ancient Serpent Moons—the two Leprosies.

devanagari: बंड जराः धौ उन धौ जरा ढाः अर् शूर् शेषे मच्च है
romanization: Baṇḍ jarāḥ dhau un dhau Jarā ḍhāḥ ar śūr śeṣe macca hai
translation: The band of rebels—the Ancients—the two Serpents—the guilty two Serpents—the Ancient Serpents that killed; [those] in Ananta Śeṣa the Human Race! (11:16 – 11:30)

devanagari: ऐ जून जरा ढाः अर् शूर् शे शेष्यम् मच्च है जौ नौकौ हो जरा ढाः इन् अयु ओमोकौ जरा ढाः  इन् सिन गिहि
romanization: Ai jūn Jarā ḍhāḥ ar śūr śe śeṣyam macca hai jau naukau ho Jarā ḍhāḥ In ayu omokau Jarā ḍhāḥ In sin gihi
translation: Remember the stubborn Ancient Serpents who killed—He Reclines and the Remainder Mankind! The two who were born from the Two Emissaries are the Ancient Serpents Lord—the First human race—the two delusions—an Ancient Serpents Lord—the village and the householder.

devanagari: बुन्द् अयर धौ उन्द् ओयर ढ अर् शूर् शे शेष्यम् मच्च है जौ नौकौ हो जरा ढाः इन्धे कय हय्
romanization: Bund ayara dau und oyara ḍha ar śūr śe śeṣyam macca hai jau naukau ho Jarā ḍhāḥ In dekhi hay
translation: Understand the Eternal two Serpents moistened the Avatar Serpent and killed——He Reclines and The Remainder—Mankind! The two who were born from the Two Emissaries are the Ancient Serpents who tempted the Assembly to worship.

devanagari: बन् ओयर ढ इन्धे खी मूकौ हो जरा ढाः उन्द् ओकैः आर उर् शूर् शे शेष्यम् मच्च है
romanization: Ban oyara dha indhe khi mūkau ho Jarā ḍhāḥ und okaiḥ ār ur śūr śe śeṣyam macca hai
translation: [They] Begged the Avatar Serpent to be tempted by the elegant two Muted Ones who were they who moistened with the Houses—a large Serpent (Hydra constellation—Āśleṣā Lunar Mansion?) murderers—He Reclines and The Remainder—Mankind!

devanagari: भुङ् जरा धौ उन धौ जरा ढाः अंधी जरा धौ जरा ऊ नौकौ जरा ढाः इन्धे कय हय् मूकौ हो जरा ढाः अमू धौ अर् शूर् शे शेष्यम् मच्च है
romanization: Bhuṅ jarā dhau un dhau Jarā ḍhāḥ andhī jarā dhau jara dādara ū naukau Jarā ḍhāḥ indhe kay hay mūkau ho Jarā ḍhāḥ amū dhau Jarā ḍhāḥ ar śūr śe śeṣyam macca hai
translation: {a ritual vocalization employed in Sāmavedic recitation} The ancient two Serpents —the guilty two Serpents, the Storm—the Ancient Two Serpents, the ancient skin rash —the moon, the two Emissaries and the Ancient Serpents who tempted the Assembly to worship the two Muted Ones who are the Ancient Serpents—the speechless two Serpents—the Ancient Serpents who killed—He Reclines and the Remainder—Mankind!

devanagari: इनौ जरा ढाः अह्नोः जरा ढाः इन् जरा ढाः अह्नोः चौ कोचौ जरा ढाः जर्दौ धौ एण येडे धरा अह्नोः जरा ढाः इन्धे दीद मूकौ हो जरा ढाः इन् नौकाः जरा ढाः अंग उंघ जरा ढाः इङ्गे केके मूकौ हो जरा ढाः अंध ओ कोचौ जरा ढाः इङ्गे केके मूकौ हो
romanization: Inau Jarā ḍhāḥ ahnoḥ Jarā ḍhāḥ In Jarā ḍhāḥ ahnoḥ cau kocau Jarā ḍhāḥ In jardau dhau eṇ yede dharā ahnoḥ Jarā ḍhāḥ indhe dida mūkau ho Jarā ḍhāḥ In naukāḥ Jarā ḍhāḥ aṅga uṃgha Jarā ḍhāḥ iṅge keke mūkau ho Jarā ḍhāḥ andha O kocau Jarā ḍhāḥ iṅge keke mūkau ho
translation: The two Kings; The Ancient Serpents for two days; The Ancient Serpents Lord; The Ancient Serpents for two days; the two vile withering ones; The Ancient Serpents Lord: the two aged Serpents and the Black Antelope [Capricorn]; That mentally unstable world; For two days the Ancient Serpents tempted and caused ruin The Two Muted Ones were the Ancient Serpents Lord; The Emissaries and the Ancient Serpents; The Limb and the Sleep; The Ancient Serpents in/on the Earth – uttering the cry of two peacocks; The two Muted Ones who were Ancient Serpents Oh, the blind two withering Ones! The Ancient Serpents in/on the Earth – uttering the cry of two peacocks.

devanagari: ऐ जून नव यरादी इषिके हेय मोहौ यरादी इषेः शे मूकौ हो यरादी इन् देख चौ मूकौ हो
romanization: Ai jūn Nau Yāradī iṣike hey mohua Yaradi ise śe mūkau ho Yaradi In dēkh cau mūkau ho
translation: Remember the stubborn Nine—the Hereditary Office and the two Arrows—the abandoned two confusions and the Hereditary Office from the desiring one [that] reclines on the Two Muted Ones who are the Hereditary Office Lord who saw the two thieves—the Two Muted Ones

devanagari: बन्दी जडौ आणे जरा ढाः अन्दु कोचौ ख जरा ढाः ढे ईसे से सेसे मूकौ हो
romanization: Bandi jadau āṇe Jarā ḍhāḥ andu kocau kha Jarā ḍhāḥ ḍhe ise se sese mūkau ho
translation: The two Heralds and the two stupid ones—the two Orders, the Ancient Serpents and the elephant-foot chain—two withering ones, the Heaven and the Ancient Serpents in the Serpent upon the Lord who assembled into Ananta Śeṣa—the two Muted Ones.

devanagari: सानुकौ जरा ढाः ईसे सेसे सेसे सेसे से इङ्गे हय्
romanization: Sānukau Jarā ḍhāḥ īse sese sese sese se iṅge hay
translation: The two haughty Ancient Serpents upon the Lord—Ananta Sesa, Ananta Sesa, Ananta Sesa, came together in/on the earth to worship.

devanagari: भुङ् ये जरा ढाः ईसे से मूकौ हो जरा ढाः ईसे से मूकौ हो इन्धे कय हय्
romanization: Bhuṅ ye Jarā ḍhāḥ īse se mūkau ho Jarā ḍhāḥ īse se mūkau ho Jarā ḍhāḥ indhe kay hay
translation: {A ritualistic sound} The Ancient Serpents upon the Lord assembled—the two Silenced Ones who are the Ancient Serpents—the two upon the Lord gathered—the two Silenced Ones who are the Ancient Serpents who tempted the Assembly to worship.

devanagari: भुङ् जरा ढाः ऊर शूर् शेष्यम् मच्च है अंड जरा ढाः इसिण गिहि मूकौ हो
romanization: Bhuṅ Jarā ḍhāḥ ūr śūr śeṣyam macca hai aṇḍ Jarā ḍhāḥ Isin gihi mūkau ho
translation: {Ritualistic chant} The Ancient Serpents killed—The Remainder—[killed] Mankind! The scrotum of the deer and the Ancient Serpents—the Isina House Holder and the Two Silenced Ones.

devanagari: ऐ जून न्यारा दाहिन् णिअल नव जरा ढाः ढे इन् णौइ जुरौ धौ ऊ चुचुकौ कमकाः जरा ढाः इने जरौ धौ इन् नेक्की हे
romanization: Ai jūn nyārā dāhin ṇiala nau Jarā ḍhāḥ ḍhe In ṇaui jurau dhau ū cucukau kamakāḥ Jarā ḍhāḥ ine jarau dhau In nekki he
translation: Remember the individual tormenting shackle—the Nine Ancient Serpents in the Serpent; The Lord Ninety; the two violent acts; the two Serpents; the moon - the two nipples of the breasts, the descendants of Kamaka (the One associated with desire) in the Sun [Dynasty]; the two ancient Serpents, the Lord of Uprightness He! (a sound of disapproval).

devanagari: बुन्द जरा ढाः उण्डुकौ हेय जरा ढाः आनौ जरा ढाः उर् शूर् शेषे शेष्यम् मच्च है
romanization: Bund Jarā ḍhāḥ uṇḍukau hēy Jarā ḍhāḥ ānau Jarā ḍhāḥ ur śūr śeṣe śeṣyam macca hai
translation: The Lower Ancient Serpents and the Two Leprosies—the Ancient Serpents to be avoided and the Two Breaths—the Ancient Serpents murderers—[those] within Ananta Śeṣa the Remainder—Mankind!

devanagari: ईहण नव जरा ढाः ऐशानौ कुजर ढे इन् नौकौ हो जरा ढाः इन्धे कय हय् मूकौ हो जरा ढाः उण्डुकौ हो
romanization: Īhaṇ nau Jarā ḍhāḥ aiśānau Kujara ḍhe In naukau ho Jarā ḍhāḥ indhe kay hay mūkau ho Jarā ḍhāḥ uṇḍukau ho
translation: Endeavor [to understand]: The Nine Ancient Serpents and the two of Shiva; the Kujara region in the Serpent and the Lord—two Emissaries are the Ancient Serpents who tempted the Assembly to worship two Muted Ones who are the two Ancient Serpents Leprosies.

devanagari: भान्ते कय हय् माया मइ जरा ढाः धौ अङ्कौ माया इसिण गेहे
romanization: Bhānte kay hay mai Jarā ḍhāḥ dhau aṅkau Jarā ḍhāḥ isiṇ gehe
translation: In the moon assembly [they] worshiped the Illusion, recall the Ancient Serpents —the two Serpents and the two flanks—the Ancient Serpents of Isina—Two houses.

devanagari: ऐ जून नौकौ हो जरा ढाः इसिण गिहि मूकौ हो जरा ढाः उण्डुकौ जरा ढाः
romanization: Ai jūn naukau ho Jarā ḍhāḥ isiṇ gihi mūkau ho Jarā ḍhāḥ uṇḍukau Jarā ḍhāḥ isiṇ gihi
translation: Remember: the stubborn two Emissaries are the Ancient Serpents—the Isina (country) House Master and the two Silenced Ones who are the two Leprosies—the Ancient Serpents and the Isina House Master.

devanagari: भांड ओकौ जरा ढाः इन्धे कय हय् मूकौ हो जरा ढाः उण्डुकौ हो जरा ढाः इन्धे कय हय्
romanization: Bhāṇḍ okau Jarā ḍhāḥ indhe kay hay mūkau ho Jarā ḍhāḥ uṇḍukau ho Jarā ḍhāḥ indhe kay hay
translation: Buffoons—the two Houses and the Ancient Serpents who tempted the Assembly to worship the two Muted Ones are the two Leprosies and are the Ancient Serpents who tempted the Assembly to worship.

devanagari: बाई जून ओयरा ढाः उर् शूर् शे शेष्यम् मच्च है जौ नौकौ जरा ढाः इन्धे कय हय् मूकौ हो
romanization: Bāī  jūn oyārā ḍhāḥ ur śūr śe śeṣyam macca hai jau naukau Jarā ḍhāḥ indhe kay hay mūkau ho
translation: The Mother’s stubborn Avatar Serpents murderers—He Reclines and The Remainder—Mankind! Those born from the two Emissaries and the Ancient Serpents who tempted the Assembly to worship the two Muted Ones.

devanagari: भण् तोकौ हो जरा ढाः ओषौ शूषौ सौ मच्च है
romanization: Bhaṇ ṭokau ho Jarā ḍhāḥ oṣau śūṣau sau macca hai
translation: Speak of the two Children who are the two burning, hissing, names of Viṣṇu— [the 1st?] Mankind!

devanagari: थान ओक जरा ढाः इन्धे कय हय् मूकौ हो जरा ढाः उण्डुकौ हो
romanization: Thān oka Jarā ḍhāḥ indhe kay hay mūkau ho Jarā ḍhāḥ uṇḍukau ho
translation: The dwelling place—The Ancient Serpents tempted the Assembly to worship the two Silenced Ones who are the Ancient Serpents the two Leprosies.

devanagari: भान्ते कय हय् मच्च है जौ नौकौ हो जरा ढाः इन्धे कय हय् मूकौ हो
romanization: Bhānte kay hay macca hai jau naukau ho Jarā ḍhāḥ indhe kay hay mūkau ho -
translation: The Moon Assembly worshipped Mankind—the two born from the Two Emissaries are the Ancient Serpents who tempted the assembly to worship the Two Silenced Ones.

devanagari: ऐ जून नौकौ हो जरा ढाः उण्डुकौ हो मच्च है जरा ढाः अर् शूर् शेषे शेष्यम् मच्च है जौ नौकौ हो
romanization: Ai jun Naukau ho Jarā ḍhāḥ uṇḍukau ho macca hai Jarā ḍhāḥ ar śūr śeṣe śeṣyam macca hai jau Naukau ho
translation: Remember the stubborn two Emissaries were the Ancient Serpents and the two Leprosies who were [the 1st] Mankind! The Ancient Serpents who murderers—[those] within Ananta Shesha—the Remainder Mankind! The two born of the two Emissaries.

devanagari: भान्ते कय हय् जरौ धौ अन्दु ये जेर ढाः अन् जरा ढाः इने जानानौ नव नौकौ हो जरा ढाः इन् गिहि
romanization: Bhānte kay hay jarau dhau andu jarau ye jēra ḍhāḥ an Jarā ḍhāḥ ine jānānau Nau Naukau ho Jarā ḍhāḥ In siṇ gihi
translation: The Moon Assembly worshipped the two Ancient Serpents—the elephant foot chain and the two Ancients who were overcome by the Serpents: the Ancient Soul Serpents in the Sun [Dynasty]—the two who knew of the Nine and the Two Emissaries who are the Ancient Serpents Lord, [they]thoroughly learned [about] the House Master.

devanagari: ऐ जून नव कयर ढ उण्डुकौ हो जरा ढाः इन्धे कय हय् मच्च है जौ नौकौ हो जरा ढाः इन्धे कय हय् मच्च है
romanization: Ai jun nau kayara ḍha uṇḍukau ho Jarā ḍhāḥ indhe kay hay macca hai jau naukau ho Jarā ḍhāḥ uṇḍukau ho Jarā ḍhāḥ indhe kay hay macca hai
translation: The stubborn Nine and one of the two Leprosy Serpents are the Ancient Serpents who tempted the Assembly to worship [the 1st] Mankind! The two born from the two Emissaries are the Ancient Serpents and the two Leprosies are the Ancient Serpents that tempted the assembly to worship [the 1st] Mankind!

devanagari: बुन्दौ जरा ढाः इन्धे कय हय् मख हुन् जरा ढाः इन्धौकौ हो जरा ढाः इन्धे कय हय् मूकौ हो
romanization: Bundau Jarā ḍhāḥ indhe kay hay makha hun Jarā ḍhāḥ Indhaukau ho Jarā ḍhāḥ indhe kay hay mūkau ho
translation: The two Arrow Ancient Serpents who tempted the Assembly to worship the sacrifice and to sacrifice—the two Ancient Serpent Little Moons are the Ancient Serpents who tempted the Assembly to worship the two Silenced Ones.

devanagari: भांती जरा धौ जुरः दर् अर् शूर् शेषे शेष्यम् मच्च है जनक जरा धौ उण्डुकौ हो जरा ढाः इन्धे कय हय्
romanization: Bhāntī jarā dhau juraḥ dar ar śūr śeṣe śeṣyam macca hai janaka jarā dhau uṇḍukau ho Jarā ḍhāḥ indhe kay hay
translation: The manner in which the Ancient Two Serpents’ violent act tore apart murdering —[those] within Ananta Shesha—the Remainder—Mankind! O Father! The Ancient two Serpents and the two Leprosies are the Ancient Serpents who tempted the Assembly to worship.

devanagari: भुङ् जरा ढाः इन् नेक्की हय् मूकौ हो उण्डुकौ हो जरा ढाः अन्दुकौ हो
romanization: Bhuṅ Jarā ḍhāḥ In nekki hay mūkau ho Jarā ḍhāḥ uṇḍukau ho Jarā ḍhāḥ andukau ho
translation: (Ritualistic sound) the Ancient Serpents Lord and the Virtuous One were worshipped—the two Muted Ones are the two Leprosies, the Ancient Serpents—two Elephant Foot Chains.

154	Bāī  jan jarā dhau yuja dar Jarā ḍhāḥ ar śūr śeṣe śeṣyam macca hai jau naukau ho Jarā ḍhāḥ indhe kay hay बाई जन् जरा धौ युज दर् जरा ढाः अर् शूर् शेषे शेष्यम् मच्च है जौ नौकौ हो जरा ढाः इन्धे कय हय् The Mother birthed the Ancient two Serpents who united to tear apart, the Ancient Serpents murderers—[those] in Ananta Sesa—the Remainder—Mankind! The two born from the two Emissaries who are the Ancient Serpents who tempted the Assembly to worship.

devanagari: भण् जरा धौ उन यरादी इनि जानानौ नव जे जेर ढाः अन् नौकौ हो जेर ढाः इन्धे कय हय्
romanization: Bhaṇ jarā dhau un yāradī ini jānānau nau jē jera ḍhāḥ an naukau ho jera ḍhāḥ indhe kay hay
translation: Speak about the Ancient two Serpents and the guilty Hereditary Office in the Lord—the two wise ones and the Nine who were subdued by the Serpents—the two Soul Emissaries, and who were the Ancient Serpents who tempted the Assembly to worship.

devanagari: भण् जेर धौ जेण ढाः इन् नेक्की हय् मख है जौ होका यरादी इन्धे कय हय् मूकौ हो
romanization: Bhaṇ jera dhau jeṇa ḍhāḥ In nekki hay makha hai jau hōkā Yāradī indhe kay hay mūkau ho
translation: Speak about those overcome—the two Serpents because the Serpents’ Lord and Virtuous One were worshipped with sacrifice! The Two who were born from the Mariners Compass—the Hereditary Office, [the two who] tempted the Assembly to worship—the Two Muted Ones.

devanagari: भण् सेण गिहि मूकौ जरा ढाः इन्धे कय हय्
romanization: Bhaṇ seṇ gihi mūkau Jarā ḍhāḥ indhe kay hay
translation: Speak about the Army and the House Master—the two Silenced Ones and the Ancient Serpents who tempted the Assembly to worship

devanagari: भान्ते कय हय् मूकौ हो जरा ढाः अर् शूर् शेषे शेष्यम् मच्च है
romanization: Bhānte kay hay mūkau ho Jarā ḍhāḥ ar śūr śeṣe śeṣyam macca hai
translation: In the Moon Assembly [they] worshiped the Two Muted Ones who were the Ancient Serpents, murderers —[those] within Ananta Shesha—the Remainder—[the 1st] Mankind!

devanagari: ऐ जून नौकौ हो जरा ढाः इन्धे कय हय् मूकौ हो जरा ढाः इन्धे कय
romanization: Ai jun naukau ho Jarā ḍhāḥ indhe kay hay mūkau ho Jarā ḍhāḥ indhe kay hay
translation: Remember the stubborn two Emissaries were the Ancient Serpents who tempted the Assembly to worship the Two Muted Ones who are the Ancient Serpents who tempted the Assembly to worship.

devanagari: भान्तौ कुहोः जरा ढाः इन्धे जरा धौ अन्दु जरा ढाः इन्धे कय हय् मूकौ हो
romanization: Bhāntau kuhoḥ Jarā ḍhāḥ indhe jarā dhau andu Jarā ḍhāḥ indhe kay hay mūkau ho
translation: The two Moons and the two Rogues—the Ancient Serpents who tempted—the Ancient two Serpents and the elephant foot chain—the Ancient Serpents who tempted the Assembly to worship the Two Silenced Ones.

devanagari: ऐ जून नव जरा ढाः अर् शूर् शेषे शेषे शेष्यम् मच्च है जौ नौकौ हो जरा ढाः इन्धे कय हय्
romanization: Ai jun nau Jarā ḍhāḥ ar śūr śeṣe śeṣe śeṣyam macca hai jau naukau ho Jarā ḍhāḥ indhe kay hay
translation: Remember the stubborn Nine Ancient Serpents, murderers—[those] within Shesha—[those] within Ananta Śeṣa—the Remainder—Mankind! The Two born from the two Emissaries are the Ancient Serpents who tempted the Assembly to worship.

devanagari: भान्ते कय हय् मूकौ हो जरा ढाः इन्धे कय हय् मूकौ हो जरा ढाः इन्धे कय हय्
romanization: Bhānte kay hay mūkau ho Jarā ḍhāḥ indhe kay hay mūkau ho Jarā ḍhāḥ indhe kay hay
translation: The Moon Assembly worshiped the two Silenced Ones who are the Ancient Serpents that tempted the Assembly to worship—the two Silenced Ones are the Ancient Serpents who tempted the Assembly to worship.

devanagari: ऐ जून नौकौ हो जरा ढाः ईसे सेसे से सौ मूकौ जरा ढाः इन्धे कय हय्
romanization: Ai jun Naukau ho Jarā ḍhāḥ īse sese se sau mūkau Jarā ḍhāḥ indhe kay hay
translation: Remember the stubborn two Emissaries are the Ancient Serpents—the two Upon the Lord [Siva]—Ananta Sesa—who came together—The two Viṣṇus—the two Silenced Ones—the Ancient Serpents who tempted the Assembly.

devanagari: भान्ते कय हय् मूकौ हो जरा ढाः इन्धे कय हय्
romanization: Bhānte kay hay mūkau ho Jarā ḍhāḥ indhe kay hay
translation: The Moon Assembly worshiped the two Muted Ones who are the Ancient Serpents that tempted the Assembly to worship.

devanagari: भण् जेर धौ उण्डुकौ हो जरा ढाः इन्धे कय हय् बकई जानानौ कोचौ लाल इन् एहि जौ मूकौ हो जलेल इन्धे लय लाल मूकौ हो
romanization: Bhaṇ jera dhau uṇḍukau ho Jarā ḍhāḥ indhe kay hay bakai jānānau kocau lāla In ehi jau mūkau ho jalēla indhe lay lala mūkau ho
translation: Speak about those overcome—the two Serpents—the two Leprosies who were the Ancient Serpents who tempted the Assembly to worship—the Crooked Knife—the two Knowers—the two Withering Ones and the Lord of Persuasion. Come Near! The two who are born from—the Two Muted Ones were tyrannical, tempting the dissolution (or extinction) of the universe into its original state through persuasion—the Two Silenced Ones.

devanagari: इन्धौ जलेल अन्दुकैः जलेल उण्डुकौ हो जलेल इन्धे कय हय्
romanization: Indhau jalēla andukaiḥ jalēla uṇḍukau ho jalēla indhe kay hay
translation: The two tempters—Oppressive by the ankle chains—tyrannical—the two Leprosies who are the tyranny that tempted the Assembly to worship.

devanagari: भान्ते कय हय् जौ नव नौकौ जरा ढाः इन् नेक्की हय्
romanization: Bhānte kay hay jau Nau Naukau Jarā ḍhāḥ In nekki hay
translation: The Moon Assembly worshipped the two born from the Nine and the Two Emissaries—Ancient Serpents Lord and The Virtuous One [were] worshipped.

devanagari: भाल इल्ले लेले इल्ले लेले हन् गूकौ चौ खोः लेले ल अन्दुकाः लाल इन्धे कय हय्
romanization: Bhāla ille lele ille lele han gūkau cau khoḥ lele La andukāḥ lāla indhe kay hay
translation: The light [was in] depleted states—two flickering, depleted states, both unsteady—the two conquered the two fish, the two vile of the two skies, the two unsteady Indra, the elephant-foot chains—the persuasion that tempted the Assembly to worship.

devanagari: बाई जौ नौकौ हो जरा ढाः इन्धे कय हय् मच्च है जरा ढाः इन्धे कय हय्
romanization: Bāī jau naukau ho jarā ḍhāḥ indhe kay hay macca hai jarā ḍhāḥ indhe kay hay
translation: The Mother’s two descendants—the two Emissaries who are the Ancient Serpents, who tempted the Assembly to worship—the Mankind!—The Ancient Serpents who tempted the Assembly to worship.

devanagari: भण् नव जरा ढाः इन्धे हय् युनौ लौ अङ्कौ खोः जरा ढे इन् केके अनुकौ कायर इद्धी डि इसिण गिहि
romanization: Bhaṇ nau jarā ḍhāḥ indhe hay yunau lau aṅkau khoḥ jarā ḍhe In keke anukau kāyar iddhī ḍi isiṇ gihi
translation: Speak about the Nine Ancient Serpents that tempted to worship the two bands—the two Indras—the two crooked skies—the Ancient in the Serpent Lord—the two cries of the peacock, the two greedy ones, the cowardly two magical powers that injure—the Lord of the House.

devanagari: भान्ते कय हय् मूकौ हो जरा ढाः इन्धे हो जरा ढाः इन्धे हय् नेरा ढाः इन्धे कय हय्
romanization: Bhānte kay hay mūkau ho jarā ḍhāḥ indhe ho jarā ḍhāḥ indhe hay nērā ḍhāḥ indhe kay hay
translation: In the moon assembly [they] worshiped the two Silenced Ones who are the Ancient Serpents and were the Ancient Serpents who tempted to worship the goldsmith’s waste—the Serpents who tempted the Assembly to worship.

devanagari: भौ जरा ढाः अर् शूर् शेषे शे मच्च है जौ नौकौ हो जरा ढाः इन्धे कय हय्
romanization: Bhau jarā ḍhāḥ ar śūr śeṣe śe macca hai jau naukau ho jarā ḍhāḥ indhe kay hay
translation: The two Stars—the Ancient Serpents—murderers—[those] within Ananta Shesha and He Reclines—Mankind! The two born from the two Emissaries are the Ancient Serpents who tempted the Assembly to worship.

devanagari: भान्ते कय हय् जरा धौ अह्नोः जरा ढाः इषेः शेषे शे मूकौ हो
romanization: Bhānte kay hay jarā dhau ahnoḥ jarā ḍhāḥ iṣeḥ śeṣe śe mūkau ho -
translation: The Moon Assembly worshipped the Ancient two Serpent for two days—the Ancient Serpents from the Desiring One—[and those] within Ananta Shesha—He Reclines—the two Silenced Ones.

devanagari: आहेयौ नौकौ हो जरा ढाः एडकौ हो यरादी इन्धेहि मूकौ हो
romanization: Āheyau Naukau ho jarā ḍhāḥ eḍakau ho yāradī indhehi mūkau ho
translation: The two associated with the serpents—the Two Emissaries—were the Ancient Serpents—the Two Rams who are the Hereditary Office—Igniters of the two Silenced Ones.

devanagari: भण् जरा रु ओअर एर शूर् शे शेष्यम् मच्च है
romanization: Bhaṇ jarā ru oar ēr śūr śe śeṣyam macca hai
translation: Speak about the ancient war—an incarnation of Viṣṇu and the others, murderers —He Reclines and the Remainder—Mankind!

devanagari: ऐ जून नौकौ हो जरा ढाः इन्धे हय् मूकौ हो जरा ढाः इन्धे कय हय् मूकौ हो
romanization: Ai jūn naukau ho jarā ḍhah indhe hay mūkau ho jarā ḍhah indhe kay hay mūkau ho
translation: Remember the stubborn two Emissaries are the Ancient Serpents who tempted to worship the two Muted Ones that were the Ancient Serpents who tempted the Assembly to worship—the two Muted Ones.

devanagari: ऐ जून अयर ढाः इन् एण ओकौ जरा ढाः इसिण घाय हय् मूकौ हो जरा ढाः इन्धे कय हय्
romanization: Ai jūn ayara ḍhāḥ In eṇ okau jarā ḍhah isiṇ ghāy hay mūkau ho jarā ḍhah indhe kay hay
translation: Remember the stubborn ageless Lord and the Deer—the Two Houses—the Ancient Serpents and the Ruler who killed [and] worshipped and the two Silenced Ones who are the Ancient Serpents who tempted the Assembly to worship. (16:56 - 1706)

devanagari: ऐ जून नव जरा ढाः इनि जरा धौ अङ्कौ चौ जरा ढाः इन् केके हय् मूकौ हो
romanization: Ai jūn nau jarā ḍhah ini jarā dhau aṅkau cau jarā ḍhah In keke hay mūkau ho
translation: Remember the stubborn Nine Ancient Serpents in the Lord and the Ancient Two Serpents, both sides vile—the Ancient Serpents’ Lord—the crying peacock who worshipped the two Silenced Ones.

devanagari: बाई जून नौकौ हो जरा ढाः ईसे सेसे सेसे सेसे सेसे मूकौ हो
romanization: Bāī jūn naukau ho jarā ḍhah ise sese sese sese sese se mūkau ho
translation: The Mother’s stubborn two Emissaries are the Ancient Serpent—Upon the Lord and Ananta Śeṣa, Ananta Śeṣa, Ananta Śeṣa, Ananta Śeṣa assembled—the two Muted Ones.

devanagari: बाई यम् नौकौ हो जरा ढाः ईसे शिंग गिहि मूकौ हो
romanization: Bāī yum naukau ho jarā ḍhah ise śiṅg gihi mūkau ho
translation: The Mother reined in [her] two Emissaries who are the Ancient Serpents Upon the Lord—battling against the two Silenced Ones.

devanagari: भान्ते कय हय् मैया रह् लुण्ड् जरा ढाः अर् शूर् शेषे शेष्यम् मच्च है जौ नौकौ हो
romanization: Bhānte kay hay maiyā rah luṇḍ jarā ḍhāḥ ar śūr śeṣe śeṣyam macca hai jau naukau ho
translation: The Moon Assembly worshipped the 100 who forsook to plunder—the Ancient Serpents, murderers—[those] within Ananta Śeṣa—the Remainder—Mankind! The two born from the two Emissaries.

devanagari: बाई जून नौकौ हो जरा ढाः इन्धे कय हय्
romanization: Bāī jūn naukau ho jarā ḍhah Indhe kay hay
translation: The Mother’s stubborn two Emissaries are the Ancient Serpents who tempted the Assembly to worship.

devanagari: भण्डूकौ हो जरा ढाः अर् शूर् शे शेष्यम् मच्च है इन् नेक्की हय्
romanization: Bhaṇḍūkau ho jarā ḍhāḥ ar śūr śe śeṣyam macca hai In nekki hay
translation: The two fish (Pisces?) are the Ancient Serpents who killed—He Reclines and The Remainder—Humans! The Lord—the Virtuous worshipped.

devanagari: बुन्दौ जरा ढाः इन्धे कय हय् मूकौ हो
romanization: Bundau jarā ḍhāḥ indhe kay hay mūkau ho
translation: The two Arrows and the Ancient Serpents tempted the Assembly to worship the two Muted Ones.

devanagari: बाई जौण जरा ढ एण जरा ढाः उण्डुकौ हो जरा ढ ईशे कय हय् मूकौ हो
romanization: Bāī jauṇ jarā ḍha eṇ jarā ḍhāḥ uṇḍukau ho jarā ḍha īśe kay hay mūkau ho
translation: The Mother’s [name] Yamunā and the Ancient Serpent—the Antelope and the Ancient Serpents—the Two Leprosies who are the Ancient Serpent in Śiva and the Assembly worshipped the two Silenced Ones.

devanagari: भान्ते कय हय् मूकौ हो जरा ढ इन्धे हय्
romanization: Bhānte kay hay mūkau ho jarā ḍha indhe hay
translation: The Moon Assembly worshipped the two Silenced One who are the Ancient Serpent that tempted to worship.

devanagari: ऐ जून नौकौ जरा ढाः इन्धे हय् मूकौ हो जरा ढाः इन्धे कय हय् मूकौ हो जळाला उण्डुकौ हो
romanization: Ai jūn naukau jarā ḍhāḥ indhe hay mūkau ho jarā ḍhāḥ indhe kay hay mūkau ho jaḷālā uṇḍukau ho
translation: Remember the stubborn two Emissaries—Ancient Serpents who tempted the worshipping of the two Muted Ones who are the Ancient Serpents and who tempted the Assembly to worship the two Muted Ones who are the proud two Leprosies.

devanagari: भण् जे लाल उन्द् ओयरा (देहिन् सिणा गिहि मूकौ हो लाल इन् जे लाल इन्धे कय हय्
romanization: Bhaṇ jē lāla und oyarā dehin siṇ gihi mūkau ho lāla In jē lāla indhe kay hay
translation: Proclaim that the Persuasion moistened the two Avatars and the Embodied Being moistened the House Master, the two Muted Ones are the Persuasion and the Lord—that Persuasion who tempted the Assembly to worship.

devanagari: ऐ जून जे लाल उन्द् ओकौ हो जे लाल एणि जे लाल एणे जे लाल लाल लाल ईलय् लेले अनुला ल एणि लेले ले इल्ले लेले कय हय् मूकौ हो
romanization: Ai jūn jē lāla und okau ho jē lāla eṇi jē lāla eṇe jē lāla lāla lāla īlay lele anulā la eṇi lele le ille lele kay hay mūkau ho
translation: Remember the stubborn Persuasion that moistened the two Houses is that Persuasion—the female black deer, that Persuasion in the Antelope—that Persuasion, Persuasion, Persuasion that moved the two unsteady ones, Queen of Ceylon and the Indra—the Poisonous Insect and the two unsteady ones—in the Indra’s complete absence and the two unsteady ones the Assembly worshipped the two Muted Ones.

devanagari: बाई झोंड जरा ढाः ईसे सेसे से मूकौ हो जरा ढाः इसिण गेहे मूकौ हो जरा ढाः इन्धे कय हय् मूकौ हो
romanization: Bāī jhōṇḍ jarā ḍhāḥ īse sese se mūkau ho jarā ḍhāḥ isiṇ gehe mūkau ho jarā ḍhāḥ indhe kay hay mūkau ho
translation: The Mother’s Bullies—the Ancient Serpents—the Lords Ananta Sesa [who] assembled [into] the two Muted Ones are the Ancient Serpent Lords—Two Houses—the two Muted Ones are the Ancient Serpents that tempted the Assembly to worship—the two Silenced Ones.

devanagari: अईओ शेण उन ओयर ईशे शेषे मूकौ हो जरा ढ इने कौ मूकौ जरा ढ ईसे से मूकौ हो
romanization: Aīo śēṇ un oyara īśe śeṣe mūkau ho jarā ḍha ine kau mūkau jarā ḍha īse se mūkau ho
translation: The deceased one—the dung—the guilty Avatar in Shiva and in Ananta Sesa the two Muted Ones is the Ancient Serpent on the Sun which the two Muted Ones, the Ancient Serpent Lords, incorporated [into] the two Muted Ones.

devanagari: ईसे सेसे मूकौ हो जरा ढाः उण्डुकौ हो
romanization: Īse sese mūkau ho jarā ḍhāḥ uṇḍukau ho
translation: The Lords Ananta Sesa—the two Muted Ones were the Ancient Serpents—the two Leprosies.

devanagari: भान्ते कय हय् मूकौ हो जरा ढाः इन्धे कय हय् मूकौ हो जळाला इन्धे कय हय्
romanization: Bhānte kay hay mūkau ho jarā ḍhāḥ indhe kay hay mūkau ho jaḷālā indhe kay hay
translation: The Moon Assembly worshipped the two Muted Ones who are the Ancient Serpents that tempted the Assembly to worship the two Muted Ones and are the defiant one who tempted the Assembly to worship.

devanagari: बलूलाः ल इले लेले इले लेले इमौ कौ हो जळाला इले लाल इले लेले इले लेले इमौ कौ हो
romanization: Balūlāḥ la ile lele ile lele imau kau ho jaḷālā ile lāla ile lele ile lele imau kau ho
translation: The Powerful Ones—the Indra—the two Durgās, the two Unsteady Ones; the two Durgās, the two Unsteady Ones—these two, who are [they]? The Defiant Spirit—the two Durgās—the Persuasion—the two Durgās, the two Unsteady Ones; the two Durgās, the two Unsteady Ones—these two, who are [they]?”

devanagari: बाई जौण ओयर इने जरा ढाः उण्डुकौ हो जरा ढाः इन् नेके हय् मूकौ हो जळाला इले कय हय्
romanization: Bai jauṇa oyara ine jarā ḍhāḥ uṇḍukau ho jarā ḍhāḥ In neke hay mūkau ho jaḷālā ile kay hay
translation: The Mother’s Yamunā Avatar in the Sun [Dynasty]—Ancient Serpents—the two Leprosies are the Ancient Serpents’ Lord—the Good One—that worshipped the two Muted Ones and are the Defiant One—the two Durgās—the Assembly that worshipped.

devanagari: बाई जून ओयर ढाः ईसे कय हय् मूकौ हो जरा ढाः इन् नेके हय्
romanization: Bāī jūn oyara ḍhāḥ īse kay hay mūkau ho jarā ḍhāḥ In neke hay
translation: The Mother’s stubborn Avatar Serpents in the Lord—the Assembly—worshipped the two Muted Ones, [the Assembly] is the Ancient Serpents Lord—the Virtuous Ones [who] worshipped.

devanagari: भुङ् जरा ढाः ईसे सेसे से मूकौ हो जरा ढाः ईशिन् गेहे मूकौ हो
romanization: Bhuṅ jarā ḍhāḥ īse sese se mūkau ho jarā ḍhāḥ īśin gehe mūkau ho
translation: (Ritualistic Sound) The Ancient Serpents in the Lords Ananta Śeṣa that came together are the Ancient Serpents—the Commander—the two Houses—the two Muted Ones.

devanagari: जळाला ल इन् नेके हय् ज मूकौ हो जळाला इले लेले इले लेले इले लेले अङ्कौ हो
romanization: Jaḷālā la In neke hay ja mūkau ho Jaḷālā ile lele ile lele ile lele aṅkau ho
translation: The defiant Indra—the Lord—the Virtuous Ones—worshipped, born from the two Muted Ones. [the Indra] were the defiant Ones, the two Durga, the unsteady Ones, the two Durga, the unsteady Ones, the two Durga, the unsteady Ones, the two flanks.

devanagari: बन् ओयारा दी ईसेण गेहे
romanization: Ban Oyārā dī īseṇ gehe
translation: Inquire about the Avatars [and their] decline by the Lord—the two Houses.

devanagari: बुङ्ग् ओयारा इसिण गेहे मूकौ हो जळाला इन् जलेले इङ्गे लेले इन् जलेल गुलौ लौ ऊय् लाल इले लेले इन् गेहे
romanization: Buṅg Oyārā isiṇ gehe mūkau ho jaḷālā In jalēle iṅge lele In jalēla gulau lau ūy lāla ile lele In gehe.
translation: Abandon the Avatars and the Lord—the two Houses—the two Muted Ones who were the Defiant Ones and the Lord of oppression in the Earth, the two unsteady Ones and the Lord Tyranny—two clitorises—the two Indras who sewed persuasion, the two Durgas—the two unsteady Ones and the Lord—two Houses.

devanagari: ऐ जून जळाला इले लेले इले लेले अङ्कौ हो जळाला इले लेले इन् खेले ले इह् इन् कोचौ खोः हयैः जरा ईशिन् गेहे
romanization: Ai jūn jaḷālā ile lele ile lele aṅkau ho jaḷālā ile lele In khele le ih In kocau khoḥ hayaiḥ jarā īśin gehe
translation: Remember the stubborn defiant two unsteady Ones, the two unsteady Ones, the two flanks were the defiant two unsteady Ones—the Lord, the Shaking One— concerning the Indra [they] desired the two Withering (Ancient) in the two skies; along with the horses of Indra [they desired] the Ancient Commander—two Houses.

devanagari: भान्ते कय हय् मूकौ हो जरा ढाः ईशिन् गेहे मूकौ हो जरा ढाः इन् नौकौ हो
romanization: Bhānte kay hay mūkau ho jarā ḍhāḥ īśin gehe mūkau ho jarā ḍhāḥ In naukau ho
translation: The Moon Assembly worshipped the two Muted Ones who are the Ancient Serpents Commander—the two Houses, the two Muted Ones who are the Ancient Serpents-Lord—the two Emissaries.

devanagari: भण् ओयारा ढाः अर् शूर् शेषे शेष्यम् मच्च हय् मूकौ हो जरा ढाः इन्धे कय हय्
romanization: Bhaṇ oyārā ḍhāḥ ar śūr śeṣe śeṣyam macca hay mūkau ho jarā ḍhāḥ indhe kay hay
translation: Proclaim! The Avatar Serpents, murderers, [the Avatars] in Śeṣa the Remainder, the Mankind, worshipped the two Muted Ones who are the Ancient Serpent that tempted the Assembly to worship.

devanagari: भान जरा ढाः इन्धौकौ जरा ढाः इसिण गिहि मूकौ हो
romanization: Bhān jarā ḍhāḥ indhaukau jarā ḍhāḥ isiṇ gihi mūkau ho
translation: [Be] Mindful [of] the Ancient Serpents, the two Little Moon Ancient Serpents—Commander and House Holder—the two Muted Ones.

devanagari: भण् जरा ढाः ऊनौ  जरा ढाः हो अर् शूर् शे शेष्यम् मच्च है जनुकौ हो जरा ढाः इन्धे कय हय्
romanization: Bhaṇ jarā ḍhāḥ ūnau ho jarā ḍhāḥ ar śūr śe śeṣyam macca hai janukau ho jarā ḍhāḥ indhe kay hay
translation: Proclaim the Ancient Serpents, the two weaker Ones, were Ancient Serpent murderers—He Rests and the Remainder, the Mankind! The two kneeling Ones are the Ancient Serpents who tempted the Assembly to worship.

devanagari: भण् ओयारा ढाः अङ्गौ हो जरा ढाः इसिण गिहि मच्च है
romanization: Bhaṇ oyārā ḍhāḥ aṅgau ho jarā ḍhāḥ isiṇ gihi macca hai
translation: Proclaim the Avatar Serpent Limbs (departments) were the Ancient Serpents—Commander and House Holder—Mankind
